title: results/<run>/report/narrative.json -- the report-generator's only output (G11): an executive summary, the risks and the recommendations, each statement citing report.json paths. `report.mjs check` fails when a number in a statement does not equal a number at one of its cited paths, or a cited path does not exist.

cite.description: A path into report.json: dotted keys, [n] for an array index, [key=value] for the array item whose key equals value, e.g. totals.approvals.awaiting, bugs[0].severity, modules[module=contacts].testcases, totals.execution.playwright-ui.failed.

text.description: One plain statement. Every number in it must equal a number at a cited path (or the length of a cited array); write numbers as digits.
